title: Integral models for constructible continuous E sheaves in degree zero
statement: For prime ℓ and finite normed E/ℚ_ℓ and a scheme X with Noetherian underlying space, let F be a constructible module over the continuous E coefficient ring of [def-weil-pbc-continuous-integral-coefficients]. The single complex F[0] is isomorphic in the ambient E derived category to integralScalarExtension(M), for an integral bounded constructible complex M. This asserts only the degree-zero case, not the result for arbitrary bounded complexes.

source.place: Lemma 6.8.13 and the sheaf case of Proposition 6.8.14(2); uses Lemma 6.8.12 for Ext1 localization

proof.text: Unpack constructibility to its finite stratification S and its locally finitely presented restrictions. For each stratum apply the ordinary stratum integral-model theorem. Apply the separate gluing theorem to these supplied models, obtaining a constructible integral module N with ordinary rationalization isomorphic to F.

Place N in degree zero. Its homology vanishes in every nonzero degree by the derived t-structure and its degree-zero homology is isomorphic to N. Constructibility transports through isomorphisms by transporting finite presentations; a zero module has the zero-by-zero presentation, the identity cover and the one-stratum stratification. Thus N[0] belongs to integralConstructible. Exact ordinary integral scalar extension commutes with the degree-zero embeddings, so its derived extension of N[0] is F[0], as required.

proof_origin.note: B4 second reading: actual Lean proof unpacks the stratification, obtains ordinary models per stratum, assembles them, proves bounded degree-zero packaging, and uses the proved exact scalar-extension theorem and upstream singleFunctor comparison. Two smaller ordinary-model holes remain; this is a decomposition, not a net proof gain.

lean.statement:
theorem continuousConstructible_integral_single_model (X : Scheme.{u})
    [TopologicalSpace.NoetherianSpace X]
    (F : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) X))
    (hF : ProEtale.IsConstructibleModuleObject
      (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) X) F) :
    ∃ M : integralConstructible ℓ E X,
      Nonempty ((integralScalarExtension ℓ E X).obj M.obj ≅
        (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj F)
